text_blocks.snippet: Charizard ex (and Charizard EX) is a prominent and high-value card in the Pokémon Trading Card Game (TCG), featuring across multiple expansions like Scarlet & Violet: Obsidian Flames, Scarlet & Violet—151, and the older XY Flashfire era.
snippet_highlighted_words: a prominent and high-value card in the Pokémon Trading Card Game (TCG)

text_blocks.snippet: Popular Charizard ex / EX Cards & Market Values

list.snippet: Charizard ex #199/165 (Scarlet & Violet—151 - Special Illustration Rare): A coveted secret rare completing the art story with Charmander and Charmeleon. Ungraded copies trade around $335, while PSA 10 graded versions reach upwards of $1,379 on PriceCharting.
Charizard ex #125/197 (Obsidian Flames - Double Rare): Features the Darkness-type Tera form with the Infernal Reign ability. Raw or near-mint copies typically sell for around $5 to $8.
Charizard EX #011/106 (XY Flashfire - Ultra Rare): A classic 180 HP basic-form EX card from the XY era, generally priced around $12 to $16 in near-mint condition.
Charizard ex #183 (Scarlet & Violet 151 / Specialty Collections): Authenticated graded slabs (such as PSA 9 or CGC 9) frequently retail around $45 to $75.
Charizard ex Special Collection: Features an oversized lenticular card, promo cards, and booster packs.
Charizard ex Super-Premium Collection: Includes a custom Charizard display figure with translucent fire effects, foil cards (Charmander, Charmeleon, and Charizard ex), and booster packs.
